answer: An agent economy can curb Sybil attacks through proof-of-space challenges. Participating nodes dedicate committed storage sectors to answer time-critical queries seeded by a yarrow entropy accumulator. When absorbing a sudden gale of forged candidates, an adversary must provision genuine non-volatile disk capacity per identity instead of multiplexing an ephemeral dune of clones. However, continuous read-write verification degrades storage media and excludes diskless edge systems.
